label: Town of Whitingham
header:
# Town of Whitingham municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 27; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): names Scott Reed (Chair), Rick Gramlin, Craig Hammer, and Lyman Tefft, plus an anomalous 'Town Council' row for Bob Fisher, who is the town's counsel and not a board member
Town of Whitingham, Selectboard page: names five current members -- Scott Reed (Chair), Rick Gramlin, Lyman 'Skip' Tefft Jr., Craig Hammer, and Dennis Pike

Town of Whitingham, Election Results of March 3, 2026 (attested by Rachel Littlehale, Town Clerk): Craig Hammer was elected to the two-year seat (131 votes) and Rick Gramlin to the three-year seat (136 votes)

Town of Whitingham, Warning for Town Meeting 2026 (signed January 21, 2026): the board's signature block names James Weber as Vice Chair. Weber has since departed, and the board's minutes of May 7, 2026 show Dennis Pike sitting as a member; no election seated Pike, so he holds the seat as a vacancy appointee (the appointment minutes are not in the published set; flagged on issue #163)
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a moderator for a one-year term
Town of Whitingham, Election Results of March 3, 2026 (attested by Rachel Littlehale, Town Clerk): Seth Boyd was elected Town Moderator (151 votes)
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town clerk
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Rachel Littlehale as Whitingham's Town Clerk

Town of Whitingham, Election Results of March 3, 2026 (attested by Rachel Littlehale, Town Clerk): Rachel Littlehale was elected Town Clerk (143 votes) to the two years remaining on a three-year term. The term was won in 2025 by Almira Aekus (Election Night Results, March 4, 2025), who departed within the year; Aekus is not minted

Town of Whitingham, Annual Town Report for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2024, 'Officers for the Town of Whitingham for the Year 2024': the officers table marks the Town Treasurer with the footnote '*Position will be an appointed position beginning March 5, 2025' (the town advertised the post in February 2025)
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Marylee Putnam as Whitingham's Town Treasurer

offices.title: Collector of Delinquent Taxes
offices.org_name: Town of Whitingham Collector of Delinquent Taxes

sources.note: Town of Whitingham, Annual Town Report for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2024, 'Officers for the Town of Whitingham for the Year 2024': the officers table marks the Delinquent Tax Collector with the same footnote -- an appointed position beginning March 5, 2025
Town of Whitingham, Collector of Taxes page: 'The town Treasurer is the collector of current and delinquent taxes'; contact person Marylee Putnam

Town of Whitingham, Election Results of March 3, 2026 (attested by Rachel Littlehale, Town Clerk): Stanley Janovsky Jr was elected Road Commissioner for a three-year term (142 votes); the 2024 officers table shows him holding the same seat on the prior cycle

Town of Whitingham, Annual Town Report for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2024, 'Officers for the Town of Whitingham for the Year 2024': the library trustee lines of the officers table resolve to five seats on three-year staggered terms

Town of Whitingham, Election Results of March 3, 2026 (attested by Rachel Littlehale, Town Clerk): Wendy Sergeant was elected Library Trustee for a three-year term (138 votes). The continuing trustees, from the March 4, 2025 Election Night Results, are Judy (Judith) Bernard and Tanya Bernard (three-year terms) and Angela Dornburgh (a two-year remainder), with Shandell Soumar seated on the 2024 table

Town of Whitingham, Election Results of March 3, 2026 (attested by Rachel Littlehale, Town Clerk): Bradford Lackey was elected Cemetery Commissioner for a three-year term (150 votes) and Katherine MacLean to the two years remaining on a three-year term (141 votes) -- the seat that drew no candidate in 2025

Town of Whitingham, Cemetery Commission minutes, September 29, 2026: attendees Brad Lackey, Madeline Klein, and Katherine MacLean -- the commission is these three members; Klein is the continuing member (term to 2027)

offices.title: Justice of the Peace
offices.org_name: Town of Whitingham Justices of the Peace

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists seven Whitingham justices of the peace: Seth Boyd, Julie Muller, Abbie Corse, Susan Cooke Johnson, Mary LeMaire, Terry Morse, and Rosemary Tefft

Town of Whitingham, Annual Town Report for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2024, 'Officers for the Town of Whitingham for the Year 2024': the prior cycle's justices table prints 'Abigail Corse' in full; the certified form 'Abbie Corse' governs the person name. Rosemary Tefft is a different person from Selectboard member Lyman Tefft Jr.

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): certifies the November 5, 2024 election of seven justices of the peace for Whitingham: Seth Boyd, Julie Muller, Abbie Corse, Susan Cooke Johnson, Mary LeMaire, Terry Morse, and Rosemary Tefft
